name: Harjot Singh
site_label: campaign home page (About and Priorities sections)
bottom_line: A short, biography-led page with few checkable claims. His law practice is documented; the personal details have no public record, and the one factual premise (rising nitrate) is supported.
findings: His firm, the Law Offices of Harjot Singh PC, is listed with the practice areas the page names, though its office is in Hicksville rather than the district.
Education, residence and family details rest on the campaign's word; no public record was found either way.
The page's statement that nitrate in local water is increasing matches USGS trend data for Suffolk public-supply wells.
page_issues: Single page with no sources, dates or endorsements.
Priorities are stated as goals without specifics or bill references.
